--chart-1: Upstream sets no charts.* color. Orca follows --primary, upstream's yellow button.background.
--chart-2: Upstream sets no charts.* color, so the series keep Orca's built-in colors.
--chart-3: Upstream sets no charts.* color, so the series keep Orca's built-in colors.
--chart-4: Upstream sets no charts.* color, so the series keep Orca's built-in colors.
--chart-5: Upstream sets no charts.* color, so the series keep Orca's built-in colors.
--sidebar-primary: Follows --primary. Upstream has one button.background for every view, the sidebar included.
--sidebar-primary-foreground: Follows --primary-foreground, upstream's button.foreground, for the same reason as --sidebar-primary.
--sidebar-accent-foreground: Follows --accent-foreground. Upstream's list.hoverForeground is the same in the sidebar and in other lists.
--sidebar-ring: Follows --ring, upstream's yellow cursor color. Upstream has one focus color for every view.
--worktree-sidebar: Follows --sidebar. Upstream has one sidebar surface, sideBar.background, so the worktree list sits on it too.
--worktree-sidebar-foreground: Follows --sidebar-foreground, upstream's sideBar.foreground, because the worktree list is part of the one sidebar.
--worktree-sidebar-accent: Follows --sidebar-accent, upstream's list.hoverBackground on the sidebar.
--worktree-sidebar-active-border: Upstream sets no outline for the selected list row. Orca mixes 18% of the sidebar text into the sidebar border, a faint edge that keeps the row's selection fill as the main cue.
--chat-user-message: Upstream sets no chat or inline chat color. Orca mixes the text color lightly into the chat background, which keeps the bubble in the theme's purple.
--diff-added-gutter: Upstream sets no diffEditorGutter color, and VS Code then tints the diff gutter from the inserted color. Orca tints it from --diff-added, upstream's inserted hue, the same way.
--diff-removed-gutter: Upstream sets no diffEditorGutter color, and VS Code then tints the diff gutter from the removed color. Orca tints it from --diff-removed the same way.
